notes.content:
- Player roles now correctly display on the team screen on PS5
- Resolved an issue where players could sometimes get stuck.
- Fixed low framerate occurring after whistle.
- Reduced Advantage Time from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds for a snappier flow.
- Reducing the risk of offensive AI players falling offside

- Improved through passes, lofted pass/cross trajectories, and pass selection
- Tuned movement, shooting, ball speed, and skill moves
- Tweaked second player press, call player short, interceptions and open goal aim assist
- Reworked blocking with new movement and animations
- Faster stumbles, and tweaked shoulder barge
- Offensive and defensive AI more coordinated and positionally aware
- Player roles added, with a set of special mentalities
- Three new formations added
- Tweaked gameplay cameras

Patch notes:
- Buffed driven pass trap cooldown
- Buffed trap reactions after post bounces
- Nerfed shot dispersion on long-range finesse shots
- Improved ball avoidance logic
- Increased passivity timer speed from 2 m/s to 3 m/s
- Stand tackles that result in penalties will no longer trigger automatic red cards for last defender
- Fixed issue with main menu navigation

Patch notes:
Removed stun effect when receiving driven passes
Fixed issue where inputs sometimes didn’t register during set pieces
Capped camera offset distance on free kicks for better visibility
Lock-on: Removed shooter priority after post bounces; all players now react instantly
Removed grace period on user-triggered runs (was previously added to prevent kick-off glitch)
Fixed an issue where some usernames could prevent players from joining matches

notes.title: Global Playtest Weekend! Starting 28th February 2025
notes.content:
The time has come! We're opening the gates of our upcoming game and will host a worldwide closed Playtest this weekend!

How to Register: Go to our Steam page, login, and simply click on “Request Access”

[b]What to expect in this playtest:[/b]

[list]
[*] Ranking System – Every match matters as you climb the ranks and prove your skills.

[*] Golden Boot Leaderboard – The top goal-scorers will be displayed for all to see on our Golden Boot web page. Will you be the one to beat?

[*] Challenges – Complete special in-game challenges to unlock exclusive rewards.
[/list]

[b]Deadline:[/b] Friday 28th February at 12:30 CET

Request access here! [url=https://rb.gy/x4uclc]GOALS Steam Page[/url]
